summary_1line: Bharata angrily condemns Kaikeyi for causing Dasharatha’s death and Rama’s exile, vows loyalty to Rama, and resolves to bring him back and serve him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata stands in the royal chamber pointing accusingly at Kaikeyi while courtiers watch in shock.
The celestial cow Kamadhenu weeps in the sky as her exhausted sons struggle under a plough in the scorching sun.
Bharata vows before the court that he will bring Rama back to Ayodhya and live in the forest himself.
